subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the stable `google-vertex` provider?
rationale: Source confirms stale visible copy, but the requested label differs from current Google wording and provider/config ids must remain stable unless maintainers intentionally design a migration.

options.title: Use Google docs bridge wording
options.body: Update user-facing labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or the maintainer-approved variant while keeping `google-vertex` stable.

options.title: Use reporter wording
options.body: Use `Google Enterprise AI` exactly as requested, accepting that it does not match the official page checked here.

options.title: Keep current label
options.body: Leave `Google Vertex AI` until maintainers decide Google’s new public naming is stable enough for OpenClaw copy.

recommendation.title: Use Google docs bridge wording
recommendation.body: Update user-facing labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or the maintainer-approved variant while keeping `google-vertex` stable.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest discussion points to BunsDev for UI/UX/docs labeling, and the decision is primarily copy/product wording rather than transport behavior.
